Game Overview

Po Santa is a platformer title where become Santa in a festive 2D platformer adventure. Navigate snow-filled landscapes, collect red gift boxes, and conquer tricky obstacles. Master the double jump to avoid hazards and outsmart colorful guards. Each level offers new challenges in this joyous holiday quest that tests your agility and timing.
